list.name: device
list.label: Host
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device_name FROM snmp_metrics WHERE device_name IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY device_name;

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, device_name AS metric, metric_value FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'cpu_load_1min' AND device_name IN ($device) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT t.timestamp AS time, t.device_name AS metric, 100.0 * (t.metric_value - a.metric_value) / NULLIF(t.metric_value, 0) AS mem_used_pct FROM snmp_metrics t JOIN snmp_metrics a ON a.device_ip = t.device_ip AND a.timestamp = t.timestamp AND a.metric_name = 'mem_avail_real' WHERE t.metric_name = 'mem_total_real' AND t.device_name IN ($device) AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp) ORDER BY t.timestamp;
SELECT node_name, disk_percent FROM node_status WHERE disk_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY disk_percent DESC;
SELECT node_name, memory_percent FROM node_status WHERE memory_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY memory_percent DESC;

WITH cpu AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) device_name, metric_value v FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name='cpu_load_1min' AND timestamp > now()-interval '1 hour' ORDER BY device_name, timestamp DESC), memt AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) device_name, metric_value v FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name='mem_total_real' AND timestamp > now()-interval '1 hour' ORDER BY device_name, timestamp DESC), mema AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) device_name, metric_value v FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name='mem_avail_real' AND timestamp > now()-interval '1 hour' ORDER BY device_name, timestamp DESC) SELECT cpu.device_name AS "Host", round(cpu.v::numeric,2) AS "CPU Load 1m", round((100.0*(memt.v-mema.v)/NULLIF(memt.v,0))::numeric,1) AS "Mem Used %" FROM cpu LEFT JOIN memt USING(device_name) LEFT JOIN mema USING(device_name) ORDER BY cpu.device_name;
